summary: Frontend-only testing of the new HeroSlider on / and updated team member photos on /about-aditya-gaur. All 10 requested behaviors verified against the live preview URL. Slider structure (6 slides, 6 dots, correct testids), autoplay advance (~5.5s), manual-dot pause, hover pause, hover-release resume, Learn More navigation to /supreme-court-criminal-lawyer and /divorce-family-lawyer, hero left-side (h1, CTAs) unchanged with hero-portrait removed, prefers-reduced-motion disables autoplay while manual dot still works, mobile 390x844 shows slider stacked below hero text with no horizontal overflow and tappable dots, /team-member.webp loads on all three team cards (naturalWidth=864) with placeholder text intact, founder card unchanged (naturalWidth=960), practice-bento with 6 category images still intact. Everything passed.
action_items: MINOR (non-blocking): HeroSlider.jsx line 75 uses JSX attribute `fetchpriority` (lowercase). React expects camelCase `fetchPriority` and logs a console warning: 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority?'. Same warning appears in any other file using lowercase fetchpriority. Rename to fetchPriority to silence the warning.
UNRELATED (pre-existing): Two 401 responses on homepage load, likely /api/articles or similar public GET being rejected. Not caused by this session's changes but worth investigating separately.
critical_code_review_comments: HeroSlider.jsx: `fetchpriority` should be `fetchPriority` (React JSX prop) — currently produces a repeating console warning on every render.
HeroSlider.jsx: onFocusCapture/onBlurCapture set the same `hovering` state as mouse hover — semantically fine but consider a separate `focused` state for clarity; low priority.
Home.jsx retains a `portraitY` scroll transform now applied to the slider wrapper — works, but the variable name is now misleading; consider renaming to `sliderY`.
context_for_next_testing_agent: HeroSlider auto-advances every 5.5s. Use waits ≥6.5s when asserting slide changes. Any manual dot click permanently disables autoplay (setManual(true) is never reset). Hover pauses autoplay via `hovering` state; leaving hover resumes it. `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` disables autoplay and CSS transitions but not manual dot switching. Team member photos use /team-member.webp (864px wide). No backend testing was performed per request. Pre-existing 401s on /api/articles observed but unrelated to this iteration.
rca of the issue: No issues found in the requested feature scope.
